content: JavaScript template literals utilize backticks to support multi-line strings and interpolation, while tagged templates function as a mechanism for string processing. By passing static string fragments and evaluated values to a custom function, developers can implement specific logic like HTML escaping to prevent XSS, internationalization, and syntax highlighting. This structure separates trusted static code from untrusted dynamic data, enabling the creation of domain-specific languages used in libraries such as styled-components and lit-html.

title: 字节腾讯阿里超三成 AI 社招岗对文科生开放
content: An analysis of 17,151 mid-career roles at ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent reveals that 32.5% of 9,183 AI positions are accessible to non-technical candidates. These roles, concentrated in product, operations, and content sectors, require soft skills like aesthetic judgment and user insight rather than programming. Companies prioritize proficiency with large language models and human-centric capabilities over strict educational backgrounds. As AI lowers technical barriers, traditional liberal arts boundaries are blurring, positioning humanistic strengths as critical assets for modern AI roles.
